A '''ruffelluff''' was a popular pet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] before going extinct. "Ruffelluff" was a code word used by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].
